userStories.title: Docs sweep (stale-reference fixes outside SKILL.md)
userStories.description: As an autonomous bookkeeper agent, I want every standing doc outside the SKILL to stop telling agents to edit plans/overview.html for task state and to start pointing at plans/overview-data.js, so that the source-of-truth shift is consistent across all human- and agent-facing references — independent of when the SKILL rewrite (US-005b) finalizes. This story is schema-shape-independent: it does NOT depend on tasks[] or phaseTree[] final content because all edits are at the file-path / parameter-name level.

plans/parallel-assignments.md top adds a 'data file is source of truth' note; bottom status table (lines 561-612) remains as a derived view.

plans/parallel-assignments.md lines 225, 235, 242, 247 — stale 'bump lastRanAt timestamp in plans/overview.html's roadmap-data JSON' and 'Add new task entries to plans/parallel-assignments.md and plans/overview.html roadmap-data JSON' phrasings — re-pointed to plans/overview-data.js.
plans/agent-view-research.md and plans/codex-agent-parity-audit.md line 1358 — references to editing overview.html for task state re-pointed to plans/overview-data.js.
plans/overview-vite-react.md lines 66 and 147 — stale ?id=foo,bar URL-filter references updated to ?tasks= (matching parseTaskIdFilter() at plans/overview.html line 3206).

plans/overview-vite-react.md adds a note that <KanbanCard> and <PhaseTreeNode> raw branches consume kanbanCards[].html and phaseTree raw nodes via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (trusted-HTML escape hatch per the master plan's Risk Area #9).
The roadmap-plugin prompt body (locate via `git grep roadmap-plugin plans/`) is updated to describe the data-file edit model, not HTML edits.

Does NOT modify .agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md (that is US-005b's territory; running this story before SKILL is finalized must be safe).
Typecheck passes (root pnpm workspace installs/builds successfully).
